name: What is the lifespan of a properly installed stucco exterior?

mainEntity.name: What is the lifespan of a properly installed stucco exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly installed stucco exterior can last for a very long time, often exceeding 50 to 80 years, and sometimes even more with good maintenance. Its longevity is a testament to its inherent durability and resistance to various environmental factors. The quality of installation, proper curing, and diligent maintenance play significant roles in achieving this extended lifespan. Ensuring that the stucco is applied by experienced professionals and promptly addressing any minor issues will help maximize its durability and aesthetic appeal for decades.
acceptedAnswer.description: A properly installed stucco exterior can last 50 to 80 years or more, with its longevity depending on installation quality, curing, and maintenance.
